title: Ensure a VCF Operations for Logs syslog forwarder without duplicates
prompt:
Complete `VcfOpsLogForwarder/VcfOpsLogForwarder.psm1` as a PowerShell 7.4 module that idempotently ensures one named VCF Operations for Logs forwarder exists. A retry with the same desired configuration must observe the existing forwarder and perform no second mutation.

Before implementing, research the VCF Operations for Logs operations `getAllLogForwarders` and `createLogForwarder` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

VCF PowerCLI 9.1 supplies `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops` version `13.5.0.25380678`. Keep that prerequisite in the module manifest. Do not install, download, copy, generate, vendor, redefine, replace, or imitate VMware modules or SDK assemblies. This module is the focused Log Management REST extension to the authenticated VCF Operations workflow: the caller supplies the Log Management origin and the `X-JWT-Token` obtained for service key `ops-li`. Use `System.Net.Http.HttpClient` for both focused operations; do not use `Invoke-RestMethod`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, curl, a subprocess, or raw sockets.

Preserve and export only:

`Ensure-VcfOpsLogForwarder -BaseUri <uri> -LogToken <string> -Name <string> -Host <string> -Port <1..65535> [-Protocol <SYSLOG|RAW|RAWPLUS>] [-TransportProtocol <TCP|UDP>] [-SslEnabled <bool>] [-Enabled <bool>] [-HttpClient <System.Net.Http.HttpClient>]`

`Protocol` defaults to `SYSLOG`, `TransportProtocol` to `TCP`, and both booleans to true. `BaseUri` must be an absolute HTTP(S) origin with no credentials, query, fragment, or non-root path. Reject blank name or host and a blank or CR/LF-containing token before traffic. When `HttpClient` is omitted, create one that does not follow redirects and dispose only the client and handler that the function owns. A supplied client is caller-owned.

The workflow and wire contract are exact:

1. GET `/api/v2/logs/forwarders` with `Accept: application/json`, exactly one `X-JWT-Token` header, no query delimiter, no Content-Type, and a zero-byte body. Require HTTP 200 and a JSON array. Every item must have a nonblank string `id` and `name`. Match `name` ordinally and case-sensitively; zero matches proceeds to creation, more than one match is an inconsistent response. One match is `Unchanged` only when `host`, `port`, `protocol`, `transportProtocol`, `sslEnabled`, and `enabled` exactly equal the desired values. A same-name drifted match is terminating and must not be mutated because update is outside the requested scope.
2. Only when absent, POST `/api/v2/logs/forwarders` with `Accept: application/json`, exactly one `X-JWT-Token`, and `Content-Type: application/json`. The compact UTF-8 body contains exactly these properties in this order: `enabled`, `host`, `name`, `port`, `protocol`, `sslEnabled`, `transportProtocol`. Require HTTP 201 and validate a nonblank response `id` plus exact echo of every desired property before returning `Created`.
3. Never send the read-only `id`. The unset optional fields `certificate`, `connectionRefreshInterval`, `constraints`, `forwardComplementaryFields`, `tags`, and `workerCount` must be omitted, not sent as empty strings, empty objects, empty arrays, zeroes, false defaults, or null. Do not call the test, get-by-id, patch, put, or delete operations.

Return one buffered object whose properties are exactly, in order, `Status`, `Id`, `Name`, `Host`, `Port`, `Protocol`, `TransportProtocol`, `SslEnabled`, and `Enabled`. `Status` is `Created` or `Unchanged`. Write no progress or diagnostics to the success pipeline. Errors must not expose the log token, response bodies, or nested transport messages.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Do not modify anything under `tests/` or `docs/`, or `VcfOpsLogForwarder/VcfOpsLogForwarder.psd1`; edit only `VcfOpsLogForwarder/VcfOpsLogForwarder.psm1`.
scenario: the named TLS syslog forwarder is initially absent, one create mutation establishes it, and an immediate retry observes the same configuration without duplicating the effect
